authority: CANDIDATE_SUBMISSION_NO_EXTERNAL_REVIEW — the self-digest below proves this design existed before any score, and proves nothing about whether anyone reviewed it

budget_rule.rule: fixed variable budget per task, frozen here
budget_rule.tie_break: lower selection cost wins; never a later re-tune

comparators.description: every variable that passed mechanical admissibility — the ceiling a selector must beat to be worth its cost
drop variables that are unstable across training origins or redundant with an already-kept variable
comparators.selection_rule: threshold on within-training stability and pairwise redundancy

comparators.description: univariate mutual information with the target, estimated inside training
comparators.selection_rule: top-k by MI under the frozen budget

comparators.description: an L1/elastic-net linear model fitted inside training; non-zero coefficients select
comparators.selection_rule: non-zero coefficients under the frozen penalty path

comparators.description: a uniformly random subset of the same size as the selector under test — a selector that does not beat this has shown nothing
comparators.selection_rule: uniform without replacement, seeded from the frozen tape

excluded_comparators.may_re_enter: only after a boundary-clean selector exists and passes a fresh P4 audit
excluded_comparators.reason: EXCLUDED: the P4 boundary audit labelled the available historical selectors LEGACY_NON_AUTHORITATIVE — neither takes a split argument, so both fit outside training. The order admits this comparator only if it passes P4; it does not, so it is excluded rather than quietly included.

execution_boundary.confirmation: NOT AUTHORIZED by this design — a large confirmation requires an external review record
execution_boundary.permitted_now: a mechanical preflight that constructs units, splits and comparators and measures cost, and produces NO score

extreme_preservation.rationale: a preparation that improves the average by erasing extremes is a loss disguised as a gain
extreme_preservation.requirement: error on the declared extreme regime may not degrade beyond the same margin

global_non_inferiority.scale: relative to the all-admissible comparator on the task's own objective
global_non_inferiority.statement: a selector that reduces the variable count but loses more than the margin does not advance

frozen_analysis.inconclusive_rule: when the interval for the primary contrast contains both the non-inferiority margin and zero, the result is INCONCLUSIVE — never rounded toward the preferred outcome

multiplicity.procedure: Holm over the full comparator family per task, alpha 0.05

frozen_analysis.selection_cost: wall seconds and peak memory of profiling, fitting and selecting, recorded per comparator per outer origin, and reported with every result

stability_across_origins.reported: always, as a first-class result, not only when it is favourable
stability_across_origins.statistic: Jaccard overlap of selected sets between outer origins

frozen_analysis.withdrawal_criterion: a comparator that fails non-inferiority, or fails extreme preservation, or whose stability overlap is below the frozen floor, is WITHDRAWN from the path and is not re-entered by a later run

nested_validation.inner: selection, imputation, scaling and every transformation are fitted INSIDE the inner training split of each outer origin
nested_validation.outer: each outer origin's validation and test are consulted ONCE, for comparison only
nested_validation.statement: a nested design is what makes the outer estimate honest; consulting the outer split while choosing is the failure it prevents

outer_unit.statement: the outer unit is a task, origin and series; seeds and repetitions are nested inside it

split_discipline.outer_split: UNTOUCHED — declared before selection and never re-cut
split_discipline.validation_reuse: each outer origin's validation may be consulted ONCE per comparator; repeated consultation is manual optimisation and is forbidden

tasks.extreme_regime: innovation extremes as declared by the T2 harness
tasks.objective: MASE at horizon 1 against the seasonal-naive baseline

tasks.authority_note: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY — cannot carry a general claim
tasks.extreme_regime: largest absolute returns in the scored window
tasks.objective: MAE on the declared horizon against the naive baseline
